question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you think Colt should stay at Spartan??

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Then I'll be Poseidon, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: What does that leave me, Hephaestus? Wasn't he way ugly?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hot wife though.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Oh, word.
Percy clears his throat and steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Gentlemen! You have taken your first step towards becoming initiated into The Immortals... A step that may well be the most significant and meaningful of your lives!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You will face three trials tonight. Trials that will test you to the very limits of your being!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Like what? Eating a whole carton of eggs? Because let me tell you, this wouldn't be the first time...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: While I'd `love` to hear that delightful tale, I'm afraid the challenges are a little more... Rigorous.
nodes.text_bbcode: While I'd [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] to hear that delightful tale, I'm afraid the challenges are a little more... Rigorous.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So like... A bucket of eggs?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: ...For the solo trial, you will be forced to recreate a famous act from Greek mythology! Each of you will be briefed by one Immortal.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And remember... Though all of you will try... Though all of you will struggle... In the end, there can be only one!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Seriously, Zeus, could you be more of a ham?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Just for that wisecrack, `Dionysus`, you're paired with Hades here. Why don't you go tell him what he's going to do?
nodes.text_bbcode: Just for that wisecrack, [color=#e23b3b][i]Dionysus[/i][/color], you're paired with Hades here. Why don't you go tell him what he's going to do?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Not like I have anything better to do...
Carson signals to Colt, and the two of them walk off together.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where are we going?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Believe me... Nowhere you'll like...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: ...Hades? The God of the Underworld?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, why not? That dude's awesome! He's got that bone dragon and that huge scythe, and when he gets mad, he's all like, 'I shall `destroy` you!'
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, why not? That dude's awesome! He's got that bone dragon and that huge scythe, and when he gets mad, he's all like, 'I shall [color=#e23b3b][i]destroy[/i][/color] you!'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Plus, his girlfriend is `ridiculously` hot, and she wears this tiny fur bikini...
nodes.text_bbcode: Plus, his girlfriend is [color=#e23b3b][i]ridiculously[/i][/color] hot, and she wears this tiny fur bikini...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Is your entire knowledge of Greek mythology based around the 1972 cult film 'Battle for Olympus'?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is that not what we're talking about?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: That's actually an awesome movie.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Yeah, it's really underrated!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Ahem! Hades it is!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: ...Hestia.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! Hestia! That's a God, right?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: It's a `Goddess.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's a [color=#e23b3b][i]Goddess.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: The virgin Goddess of the hearth and domesticity.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Oh.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oh.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is she cute at least?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey, if he wants to be Hestia, let him be Hestia! He can cook us dinners and clean our clothes!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: As delightful as that would be, it would be an insult to this society. You must choose a `male` deity.
nodes.text_bbcode: As delightful as that would be, it would be an insult to this society. You must choose a [color=#e23b3b][i]male[/i][/color] deity.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: How about Hades? He's certainly `killing` the mood.
nodes.text_bbcode: How about Hades? He's certainly [color=#e23b3b][i]killing[/i][/color] the mood.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! Hades! I'll be that guy!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Fine. Hades it is.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: ...Herplop.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You want to be known as the Greek deity 'Herplop.'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! You know, good ol' Herplop.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He was... Uh... This big dude... With... Uh... Horns? I think he had horns...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And pray tell, what was Herplop the God of?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Cows?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey, if he wants to be the God of Cows, I think we should let him!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: As delightful as that would be, it would be an insult to this society. You must choose a `real` deity.
nodes.text_bbcode: As delightful as that would be, it would be an insult to this society. You must choose a [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] deity.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: How about Hades? He's certainly `killing` the mood.
nodes.text_bbcode: How about Hades? He's certainly [color=#e23b3b][i]killing[/i][/color] the mood.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! Hades! I'll be that guy!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Fine. Hades it is.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, if you really want in, why don't you just take my spot in the initiation? I'm really not that into it...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's not that simple, Colt. For starters, you aren't in yet. First, you have to pass their initiation challenges!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, so why don't I ask them if you can take the challenges or whatever with me?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's a nice gesture, but that's not how it works...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: At least... I don't `think` that's how it works...
nodes.text_bbcode: At least... I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]think[/i][/color] that's how it works...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You have no idea, do you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, it `is` a secret society! It wouldn't be very secret if I knew all their policies!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a secret society! It wouldn't be very secret if I knew all their policies!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So you don't know. Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: They want me to meet them in the math classroom at midnight, right? That's in ten minutes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We'll both go there, and then we'll see what they have to say!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You'd do that? For me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Thanks, Colt. I really appreciate it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, don't get all touchy-feely. Just get your shoes on and let's go.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sure! Give me just a moment to get ready!
`Forty-five` minutes later, Colt and Tom walk to the math classroom...
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Forty-five[/b] minutes later, Colt and Tom walk to the math classroom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Seriously dude! What is wrong with you? You take longer to get dressed than any girl I've ever dated!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That says much more about the floozies you date than it does about me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! Watch it!
The two of them reach the math classroom.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... Here goes...
Colt throws open the door. The two step in... To a completely empty room.
Algebra facts are written on little posters on the walls. The teacher's desk is covered with math-related objects: a compass, a ruler, and an abacus.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Great. We missed it. Was the moisturizing really worth it, Tom? Was it?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Good skincare is always worth it... And besides, I'm not so sure we did miss it. Look.
Tom points to the whiteboard where a lightning bolt has been drawn. Underneath it is some text...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: 'To enter our lair in the gloom...'

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: 'First find the monarch of this room!'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't get it.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's a riddle!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The first step of the initiation ritual is solving a riddle? What's next? Peekaboo? Hide-and-seek? Maybe we can play duck-duck-goose!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This is no time to fantasize about hunting fowl!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now think... What could the 'monarch of the room' refer to?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, well, there's two dudes here, and `I'm` pretty obviously the monarch. I mean, I do rule...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, well, there's two dudes here, and [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] pretty obviously the monarch. I mean, I do rule...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You the monarch? Please. My name is Tom `Prince.` Your name is Colt `Chimneysweep!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You the monarch? Please. My name is Tom [color=#e23b3b][i]Prince.[/i][/color] Your name is Colt [color=#e23b3b][i]Chimneysweep![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's Colt `Warren!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's Colt [color=#e23b3b][i]Warren![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Reasonable guess. Besides, the riddle probably doesn't refer to a person but an object...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait a minute... I think I know this...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're looking for a...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That doesn't make any sense!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh... Right...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Think again, Colt... It's an object in this `math` classroom... An object that could be described as a monarch...
nodes.text_bbcode: Think again, Colt... It's an object in this [color=#e23b3b][i]math[/i][/color] classroom... An object that could be described as a monarch...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, okay... Now I got it...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're looking for a...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That makes even `less` sense!
nodes.text_bbcode: That makes even [color=#e23b3b][i]less[/i][/color] sense!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Made sense in my head...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Let's see... These riddles are usually a play on words... So what's a synonym for monarch?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: King... Queen... Emperor... Empress...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ruler...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Lady Ruler?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait! That's it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, I'm pretty sure I just made up 'Lady Ruler'...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, just ruler! That's the answer! We're in a math classroom... We should be looking for a ruler!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw, that's lame...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A ruler is another name for a monarch, and we're in a math classroom! We must be looking for a ruler!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wow, Colt, that's actually... Very clever of you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, when you've got a little sister, you get pretty good at riddles...
Tom walks across the room to the teacher's desk and picks up a prominent, solid-gold ruler.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hmmm... That doesn't seem to have done anyth...
A rumbling roar cuts Tom off! The whiteboard swings aside, revealing a hidden passage and a flight of stone stairs leading down into darkness!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, I'll admit it, `that` was pretty cool.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, I'll admit it, [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] was pretty cool.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Not to mention it demonstrated remarkable craftsmanship... I'd `love` to know who they contracted this to!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not to mention it demonstrated remarkable craftsmanship... I'd [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] to know who they contracted this to!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I mean, do you have any idea how hard it is to set up a good secret passage?
Tom and Colt descend down the stairs...
Into a lovely and well-furnished den!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Huh... Not what I was expecting...
A curtain at the far end of the room swings aside, revealing Percy, Carson, Chad and Preston!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Welcome... To the `Den of The Immortals!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Welcome... To the [color=#e23b3b][i]Den of The Immortals![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As soon as Chad sees Colt, he lunges forward!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You son-of-a...
Percy grabs Chad and hurls him across the room!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Stay your hand!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: But... `That` guy? He punched me out!
nodes.text_bbcode: But... [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] guy? He punched me out!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Which is precisely why I invited him. Believe me, you had it coming.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: I don't, however, recall inviting Thomas here...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well... You see... Colt actually invited me...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is an initiation test, isn't it? I just figured, if I get a shot, Tom should too. May the best man win, right?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Unbelievable! He hasn't even been in the room two minutes, and he's already trying to upend the rules of our society!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I'm telling you, Percy, letting him in would be a terrible idea...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Your opinion has been duly noted... Though if you really cared about the rules of our society, you might consider addressing me by my proper name.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Right. Sorry, `Zeus.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Right. Sorry, [color=#e23b3b][i]Zeus.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Now then... What do the rest of you think of it?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I think we should let them both try out. Pitting friend against friend? Now `that's` a challenge!
nodes.text_bbcode: I think we should let them both try out. Pitting friend against friend? Now [color=#e23b3b][i]that's[/i][/color] a challenge!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Not to mention it might actually make this whole thing `not` totally boring. I say we do it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not to mention it might actually make this whole thing [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] totally boring. I say we do it.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Then it's decided! This year's Immortals Initiation Challenges will be undertaken by Colt... Tom...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Lee and Mark!
Colt and Tom glance to the side of the room, where Lee and Mark are sitting quietly on the couch.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh... Hey guys.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Yo.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Alright, let's just get this goofshow started, shall we? What do I have to do?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: The first step in joining The Immortals is choosing which deity you will embody. I, as the leader of this society, am `Zeus.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The first step in joining The Immortals is choosing which deity you will embody. I, as the leader of this society, am [color=#e23b3b][i]Zeus.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're doing this? Really? We're actually doing this?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I'm Ares, because I will `mess. You. Up!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm Ares, because I will [color=#e23b3b][i]mess. You. Up![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I'm Dionysus. Who doesn't love a good party, right?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: And I'm Hermes!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'd like to be Apollo!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I'd like to be...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know, maybe they just thought I'm a better fit.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: In what way are you a better fit than me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, let's see. For starters, I'm way better at fighting than you are...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's negligible...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm better-looking...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Debatable...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I'm better at kissing!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: How would you even measure that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, Tom... You're a spoiled, snobbish rich brat who's never had to work a day in his life, and I'm a cool, rebellious bad boy who drives a motorcycle.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's really a no-brainer.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe, if we were talking about membership in the International Order of Highwaymen!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The Immortals don't care how you fight, and they certainly don't care what you drive. They're composed of this school's brightest, savviest, and most ambitious.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I mean, do you even know what a hedge fund is?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's like a fancy garden, right?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...I rest my case.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What are you talking about? Who doesn't like me? I'm so charming!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, dude, I hate to break it to you, but you rich people have more enemies than my Uncle Bo, and he used to introduce himself to people by headbutting them.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Your family really puts the class in 'lower class', don't they?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, all I'm saying is, isn't it possible that some of the guys in this secret society see you as a rival?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hmm... You know, you might be right...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm always right.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: There `are` plenty of miscreants at this school who are consumed with jealousy over my fortune...
nodes.text_bbcode: There [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] plenty of miscreants at this school who are consumed with jealousy over my fortune...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's actually not what I said...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: They hate that I'm so wealthy... So charming... So devilishly handsome...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's `definitely` not what I said...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#e23b3b][i]definitely[/i][/color] not what I said...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: In fact, they probably invited you just to spite me! Those hateful little goblins!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Are you even hearing me at this point?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If only there was some way I could force them to let me in...
Late one night, at Spartan High, a letter slides under the door to Tom and Colt's room!
Colt walks over and holds it up...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What is that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Some kind of letter. It's got this weird seal on it, like a lightning bolt...
Tom's face goes white. His eyes open wide with disbelief.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh... My...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Did you just say... A `lightning bolt?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you just say... A [color=#e23b3b][i]lightning bolt?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, jeez, calm down. It's not like it's made out of gold...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Actually, with you Spartan guys, it might be...
Tom scrambles over, pawing at Colt.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Give it to me! Give me the letter!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Calm down, Silver Spoon, it's addressed to me!
Colt rips open the letter. A fancy parchment tumbles out. He picks it up and reads it, while Tom frantically peeks over his shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's see here... Dear Colt, blah blah... Secret society, blah, blah... Initiation ritual, meet in the math class at midnight, yawn....

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Boring!
Colt tosses the letter towards the trash. Tom dives, catches it mid-air, and smacks into the wall!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What is wrong with you?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's wrong with `me?` You're the dude that just lunged head-first into a wall!
nodes.text_bbcode: What's wrong with [color=#e23b3b][i]me?[/i][/color] You're the dude that just lunged head-first into a wall!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This letter is from The Immortals!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The 80s cover band?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No! The Immortals is Spartan Academy's elite and powerful secret society!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do I care? I hate secrets, and I hate societies.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You've got tons of secrets!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, but I don't `like` them.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]like[/i][/color] them.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Listen to me, Colt. You've just been given a chance to be initiated into The Immortals! This is huge!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know, man. It sounds kind of lame. All I'm picturing is a bunch of lame, rich guys standing around in togas and admiring each other's muscles.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: First of all, if that's the first thing you picture, you should probably consider seeing a psychiatrist...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And second, The Immortals are a lot more than just some preppy club house.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Not only do they basically run this school out of their inner sanctum, the `Den of The Immortals...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not only do they basically run this school out of their inner sanctum, the [color=#e23b3b][i]Den of The Immortals...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Their members always go on to be incredibly wealthy and powerful members of society! Senators... Movie stars... Even hedge fund managers!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know... Will I have to wear a toga?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And `I'm` the one who should see a psychiatrist?
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] the one who should see a psychiatrist?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, Colt, this is the opportunity of a lifetime. It's a huge honor.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You said you wanted to be a better man, right? That's why you're here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, The Immortals are the `best of the best,` Colt. If you want to put your criminal ways behind you and succeed in this world... This is the shot of a lifetime.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, The Immortals are the [color=#e23b3b][i]best of the best,[/i][/color] Colt. If you want to put your criminal ways behind you and succeed in this world... This is the shot of a lifetime.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah. Really.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: In fact, I... I don't really understand why `you` got it... I mean, I always wanted to be a member, I just figured it was a matter of time...
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, I... I don't really understand why [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] got it... I mean, I always wanted to be a member, I just figured it was a matter of time...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why would they invite you and not me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gee, I don't know, Tom. Maybe it's because...
Colt holds his breath and sprays, frantically blasting the room with water!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, come on!
Manure sprays away, but it's not enough! Horses neigh and whinny!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Can't take much more of this...
The smell starts to become overwhelming! Colt's hands tremble and shake!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't fail `now...` I mean, I was on fire for the previous trials...
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't fail [color=#e23b3b][i]now...[/i][/color] I mean, I was on fire for the previous trials...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait a minute... `On fire...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a minute... [color=#e23b3b][i]On fire...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt glances up at the ceiling where several fire sprinklers jut out of the woodwork...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hope this works...
Colt grabs the side of a stall, pulls himself up with one hand, and jams his lighter under a smoke detector!
With a hiss, the sprinklers burst to life, spraying the room with water and washing away the manure!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A-ha!
You jump down and rush out of the stables, proudly wiping your hands clean.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stables... Cleaned!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: And horses terrified, but I suppose I didn't specify anything about that.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I have to give you credit... I didn't think you'd be able to pull this off.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is there anything fire `can't` fix?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is there anything fire [color=#e23b3b][i]can't[/i][/color] fix?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ha!
Carson pats Colt on the back, and the two head back to the hidden lair.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I gotta say, Colt...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I think things around here are going to be a lot less boring with you around...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: After great consideration, we have decided that the newest member of The Immortals will be...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Hephaestus!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Yes! This is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is crap!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Actually, it's totally logical. He was `way` better than the rest of you guys.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, it's totally logical. He was [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] better than the rest of you guys.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah! He's way better than losers like you!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Except Mark. He's okay.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Can we appeal?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: I'm sorry, dear Thomas, but all decisions are final and permanent.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Now please do us all a favor and get out of here. We Immortals have business to conduct...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: `Secret` business.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Secret[/i][/color] business.

nodes.text: Back in their room, Colt and Tom pace around, angrily...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Man, this sucks! All that, and we `still` didn't get in?
nodes.text_bbcode: Man, this sucks! All that, and we [color=#e23b3b][i]still[/i][/color] didn't get in?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I know! I think it was rigged from the start!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! Those jerks! I bet their secret society sucks anyway! What do they know about having a good time?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Nothing! You and I could have a way better time without them!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait a minute... Tom... I just had a crazy idea...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Are you thinking what I'm thinking?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That it's really a good time to divest my shares in Swiss pork bellies?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! We should totally form our own secret society! We could put theirs to shame!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah! That's a great idea!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We could call ourselves 'The Even More Immortals!'

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Let's just table the name for now.
Later that day, in the Spartan cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Attention one and all! We'd like to announce the formation of a `new` secret society!
nodes.text_bbcode: Attention one and all! We'd like to announce the formation of a [color=#e23b3b][i]new[/i][/color] secret society!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah! And it'll be way better than those crappy Immortals!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If you'd like to join, please meet us in the Quad at midnight!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, hey guys. Quick question...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's up, Captain Emo?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: If this is a `secret` society, why are you shouting about it in the cafeteria?
nodes.text_bbcode: If this is a [color=#e23b3b][i]secret[/i][/color] society, why are you shouting about it in the cafeteria?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That... Is an excellent point.
And later that night...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well? How'd your recruitment go?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Terribly!` No one wanted to join our secret society! Plus the headmaster wrote me up for soliciting, and I don't even know what that means!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Terribly![/i][/color] No one wanted to join our secret society! Plus the headmaster wrote me up for soliciting, and I don't even know what that means!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How about you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I did find one recruit...
Tom steps aside, revealing...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hola! Mi nombre es Erik!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's a secret clubhouse, right? I figured we'd all be talking in code!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Is your code just speaking in Spanish?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ho ho! Aren't you some Clever Cathies!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Now then! What's on the agenda? Board games? Lemonade? Silly wigs?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Because let me tell you, I have `quite` the silly wig collection...
nodes.text_bbcode: Because let me tell you, I have [color=#e23b3b][i]quite[/i][/color] the silly wig collection...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ergggggh.
A secret society like that is no secret society at all! This can't be the way it ends!
Try again, and see if you can do a better job!

Thanks for playing!
