nodes.text: Colt delivers a devastating punch to Tom's side!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ooooof!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ouch...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Brutal!
Tom stumbles weakly, trying to regain his footing...
And Colt shoves him in the chest as hard as he can, sending him tumbling backwards over the coffee table! Tom hits the ground hard and lies there...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That... Really... Hurt...!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Boom! What a rush! I'd forgotten how fun a good fight could be!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well, that was unexpectedly fast and efficient!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Kind of boring too...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: I'm excited to announce that the newest member of our order will be... Hades!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heck yeah it will!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Now then... The first item on our agenda is...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa, hold your horses there, Poofball. I'm not done fighting yet!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I challenge... Chad!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Wait, what? You can't challenge me!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Actually... According to the bylaws of The Immortals... He can.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Volume 3, Article 7. Any member of The Immortals may challenge a superior member for status via either a bout of hand-to-hand combat, or a vigorous game of hide-and-go-seek.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's right! Hand-to-hand combat! Now come on, Meathead... Get over here!
A few minutes later, Chad lies unconscious on top of Tom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Unf! Yeah! That is how we do it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now get over here, Chuckles! You're next!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Sigh. Let's just get this over with...
And a few minutes after that, only Percy and Colt are left!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, Shaggalicious, let's do the man-dance!
Percy assumes a terse, combative stance...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You overzealous buffoon, I'll have you know that I've been trained in jiu jitsu and tae kwan do!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah? You know what I'm trained in? A little bit of the ol' kick-yo-butt!
Colt swings his foot in a low sweep, kicking Percy's feet out from under him! He tumbles back, smacks into the coffee table, and rolls onto the pile of unconscious guys!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah! Who's number one? Who's `number one?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah! Who's number one? Who's [color=#e23b3b][i]number one?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's me, in case you were wondering. `I'm` number one.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's me, in case you were wondering. [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] number one.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ugggggh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now then! As leader of The Immortals, I'm changing my name from Hades to Dragonsaurus Rex!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I'm also changing the point of the club! From now on, it's all about fighting! Fighting all the time!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: In fact, from now on... It shall be known as `Fist Club!`
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, from now on... It shall be known as [color=#e23b3b][i]Fist Club![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa... Weird... Why did I just have a sudden urge to watch wrestling and call up Sam?
Colt turning into Spencer? That's `definitely` not right!
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt turning into Spencer? That's [b]definitely[/b] not right!

nodes.text: The truth is...
At the other end of the field, Colt jogs over to the Spartan guys and tosses Tom the empty salt bag.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What was all that about? Who's the girl?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't you worry your rich, little head. Let's just get out of here.
A little while later, in the Den of The Immortals...
The four initiates sit on the couch. The Immortals convene at the far end of the room.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You okay, Colt? You look a little down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's nothing, man, don't worry about it.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Ahem! The Council of Immortals has reached their verdict!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Finally!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Is that what this is? Some dumb school pride thing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe... I mean, that's one way of looking at it...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't understand... You `never` cared about that kind of thing when you were at Centerscore...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't understand... You [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] cared about that kind of thing when you were at Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Suddenly you go to Spartan, and you're, what, this big conformist?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, it's not like that. There are these trials I have to do, you know... To get in with The Immortals...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, what are you `talking` about?
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt, what are you [color=#3b78e2][i]talking[/i][/color] about?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't have an easy answer for you, okay? I said `it's complicated!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't have an easy answer for you, okay? I said [color=#e23b3b][i]it's complicated![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Fine then! If this is the kind of guy you want to be, then go right ahead.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I just... I thought you were better than this.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I guess you don't know me that well, do you, Princess?
Colt turns and rushes off.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt... Wait...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And you're doing that by... Ruining our football field?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: When you put it like that, it does sound kind of crazy... But I promise you it makes sense...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How, Colt? How does it make sense? Because right now, I'm seriously worried about your mental health!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, I... It's not like that. I promise you, my mental health is `fine.` This is just a thing I have to do.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I... It's not like that. I promise you, my mental health is [color=#e23b3b][i]fine.[/i][/color] This is just a thing I have to do.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But why? This just doesn't seem like you at all...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, maybe I don't `want` to seem like me, okay?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, maybe I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to seem like me, okay?!

nodes.text: Colt sighs deeply.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, Princess. The Colt you know... The Colt you `think` you know...
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Princess. The Colt you know... The Colt you [color=#e23b3b][i]think[/i][/color] you know...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He's not a good guy, okay?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's `not` true.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] true.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It `is` true. I'm reckless, and I'm selfish, and I hurt the people I care about. You of all people should know that.
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] true. I'm reckless, and I'm selfish, and I hurt the people I care about. You of all people should know that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right now, I'm trying as hard as I can to become a better guy. And you know what? I don't really know how.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I'm trying, okay? And honestly, sometimes, that might mean I make mistakes or do things I'm not really sure about...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Like... Pouring salt all over the football field?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, exactly. So do me a favor, and don't judge me too much, okay? Not yet.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm not judging you, Colt... I care about you...
Behind Colt, from the wooden horse, several guys shout...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Come on, Colt! We gotta get back to Spartan!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah! The Immortals are waiting!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What part of `secret` society don't you get, Mark? Seriously!
nodes.text_bbcode: What part of [color=#e23b3b][i]secret[/i][/color] society don't you get, Mark? Seriously!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What are they talking about?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing. Don't worry about it. I... I gotta get going.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Right.
Colt pats Denni awkwardly on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: See you 'round, Tiny Hipster.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...You too.
Denni sadly watches him go...
A few minutes later, Colt paces onto the football field. It's been completely devastated by the wooden horse, torn up with huge, deep rifts.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, they're all gone.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah, and the field's all ruined, no thanks to you.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Pushing a giant horse is `seriously` not easy...
nodes.text_bbcode: Pushing a giant horse is [color=#e23b3b][i]seriously[/i][/color] not easy...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, neither is betraying a bunch of people you used to call friends. Can we just go back to Spartan now?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Not yet. We've razed the field... But we still have to salt it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I thought that was just a metaphor. You know, like, 'stop, drop, and roll'?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: You don't know what a metaphor is, do you?
Tom leans into the horse and pulls out a heavy bag of salt. He tosses it to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ooof!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well? Salt away!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why me?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Because you took forever to distract the cheerleaders, dude! Now go do it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Man, this blows...
Colt pulls open the bag and runs around the field, frantically dumping salt everywhere...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't even know... Why ancient warriors did this... It's not like they were gonna... Taste the dirt...
Just as he's about to dump the last of the salt, he hears a familiar voice...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Colt?!
Colt spins around to see Denni standing behind him!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tiny Hipster! Hey! What... What are you doing here so early?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Inside?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I couldn't help but overhear your conversation... And it sounds like you're having some problems with the routine...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're telling me! These lazy butts are acting like they barely even care!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're just.... So tired...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, see, whenever I'm really having trouble getting motivated with something, I like to change up where and how I'm doing it.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Like, if I was stuck on a problem in my math homework, I'd go outside, get some fresh air, and try again!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You do your math homework?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I said 'if.'

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Even if we tried this idea... Where would we practice?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How about in a classroom? That could be crazy, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know, Colt, that sounds a little risky...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If $ZOE thinks it's risky, that means it's probably totes fun! Let's do it!
And so, a few minutes later, the cheerleaders have gathered in a classroom, and are standing on desks!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right, girls! The challenge is to practice our routine without falling down!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Heh... This is actually kind of fun!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah! Everything's more fun when it's `dangerous!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! Everything's more fun when it's [color=#3b78e2][i]dangerous![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...I really worry about you girls sometimes.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, has anyone seen Amanda?
The door swings open, and Amanda rushes in.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: There's a giant wooden horse spinning around on the football field!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sure there is, Manda-Panda. Sure there is.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thanks, Colt! I think you really helped Centerscore out today!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess I did...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: A stroll?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, you know... A nice, happy stroll around the campus... Hear the sights, see the sounds... A real trip down memory lane!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why would we possibly want to take a trip down memory lane? We still go here!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh... Right...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, uh, maybe we should, you know, see if anything's going on... Crazy things are always happening on this campus, aren't they?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Uh, no they aren't... Not at `5:30` in the morning!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, no they aren't... Not at [color=#3b78e2][i]5:30[/i][/color] in the morning!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Is this some kind of an elaborate ruse to make out with us? Because that's the only thing I'd be interested in.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm not interested either way...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Seriously though, the sooner this is done, the sooner I can take a nap. So if you're just trying to make small talk, can you just leave us alone?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Right.
Colt wanders back to the campus...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Man, when did I get so bad at this? I used to be really good at hustling people...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well... When in doubt...
Colt leans over and pulls the fire alarm! A blaring alarm blasts through the school!
A few minutes later, the cheerleaders come running by...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: A fire alarm? `Again?`
nodes.text_bbcode: A fire alarm? [color=#3b78e2][i]Again?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It wasn't me this time! I swear! I don't even `have` any more candles!
nodes.text_bbcode: It wasn't me this time! I swear! I don't even [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] any more candles!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on, lazies! We'll just have to practice in the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Enough distraction! Remove the handcuffs!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah...
Carson walks over and removes the handcuffs from all the guys.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, third and final challenge time. What have you got?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: The final challenge will be a `Group` Trial! All of you will be in it together.
nodes.text_bbcode: The final challenge will be a [color=#e23b3b][i]Group[/i][/color] Trial! All of you will be in it together.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Saw that coming...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: And what exactly will we be doing?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You have been tested in myth... You have seasoned the great wilds... And finally, you must master that most ancient and Spartan of pursuits...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Warfare.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw man, is this all some kind of elaborate recruitment drive? Because I am `not` joining the Army...
nodes.text_bbcode: Aw man, is this all some kind of elaborate recruitment drive? Because I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] joining the Army...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: In times of war, the Spartans would decimate their enemies' villages, and then salt the ruins so that nothing would ever grow there.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Tonight, you will do the same!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You will infiltrate the campus of our greatest rival, Centerscore High...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Then, you will devastate their football field and salt the ruined earth!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: How are we supposed to ruin the field in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: By plowing it with a giant wooden horse!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why did I even ask...?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You can find the giant horse outside. Complete this challenge... And become worthy of being Immortal!
Most of the other guys file out. Colt stays behind with Tom.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey... Hold on a moment, Fancypants.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What's wrong? Let's go get this stupid thing over with.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know, man, messing with Centerscore? That doesn't feel right...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why not? Because it's your old school?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, yeah, dude. It might not be my school anymore, but I had some pretty good times there. It feels weird to suddenly be trying to ruin their field...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Colt, you're a Spartan now. That makes Centerscore your biggest `rival.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt, you're a Spartan now. That makes Centerscore your biggest [color=#e23b3b][i]rival.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know, but still... You're just cool with it? Doesn't `your` girlfriend go to Centerscore?
nodes.text_bbcode: I know, but still... You're just cool with it? Doesn't [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] girlfriend go to Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Barely. She spends most of her time in that bakery, and it's not like she cares about football.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Honestly, she'd probably think it was funny.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ehhh... It just seems wrong to me, man...
Tom steps forward and puts his hand on Colt's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, Colt, I get it. It's your past, and you're not ready to give up on it.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But you're the one who wanted to turn over a new leaf. You wanted to become a new man. A better man.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And that means messing up a football field?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It means committing to who you are. And that means being a Spartan... An Immortal.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Yeah. I guess.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now come on. Let's do this thing.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Right.
A little while later, the four guys push a giant wooden horse up to the Centerscore football field. The first rays of sunrise drift over the horizon.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We're gonna have to do this quickly, gents... Morning's coming fast!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Yeah... And that's not our only problem!
Lee points across the field where a bunch of Centerscore cheerleaders are practicing!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?! It's 5:30 in the morning! What are they doing here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Centerscore cheerleaders, man... It's all `kinds` of crazy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Centerscore cheerleaders, man... It's all [color=#e23b3b][i]kinds[/i][/color] of crazy.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Well, we're not going to be able to mess up this field while they're on it.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Colt! You have an in with them! Go distract them so we don't get caught!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I'm on it...
Colt walks across the field to the cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on, girls! Let's see some lunges! And this time, put some `spirit` into it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, girls! Let's see some lunges! And this time, put some [color=#3b78e2][i]spirit[/i][/color] into it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Jessica, I'm just really tired...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Me too... We've been doing this all night!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, I know. All night practice! Why didn't you just sleep during the day?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We were in class...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not following.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey there, ladies...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Colt! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm, uh, just, you know, hanging out, seeing the old alma mater...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Your grandma lives here?
Behind the cheerleaders, on the outskirts of school, the other Spartan guys gesture angrily...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So, listen, why don't we...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's the Spartan way, right? Fight! With, you know, honor!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Fight? Fight how?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know, punch them?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: `You` punch them!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] punch them!

nodes.text: One of the badgers lunges forward, snapping its jaws!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Does that thing have three rows of teeth?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Agggggh!
Colt lunges forward, kicking at a badger! It ducks effortlessly under his foot, and he tumbles down, dragging Tom with him!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ooof!
The badger lumbers forward and rears up. Tom desperately raises his hand to block it...
And a blast of shaving cream shoots out of his watch, nailing the badger in the face!

nodes.speaker: Badger
nodes.text: Hsssss!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey! That worked!
Tom waves his hand around, shooting shaving cream like confetti. The badgers snarl and retreat, vanishing into the darkness...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Dude... Next time I rag on one of your stupid rich guy gadgets, feel free to slug me in the face.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it was your bright idea to fight, wasn't it?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh... I guess it was!
Five minutes later, Colt and Tom come strolling back into The Immortals' den...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey guys! How's it going? Wondering who just `aced` your second test?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey guys! How's it going? Wondering who just [color=#e23b3b][i]aced[/i][/color] your second test?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, that's right! It was us! Tom and Colt!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Apollo and Hades.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right, right.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well, I must say, I'm impressed. You two may have just set a new Immortals record...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hrmph... Beginner's luck...
Just then, the door to the room swings open, and Mark and Lee stagger in. Their clothes are torn, and they're all scratched up.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Did you know there's a bunch of pissed-off honey badgers covered in shaving cream out there?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We... Uh... Might know a thing or two about that, yes...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Go! Run! `Run!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Go! Run! [color=#e23b3b][i]Run![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt and Tom bolt as fast as they can...
But Colt goes right and Tom goes left! The handcuff binding them pulls taut, and the two go crashing down!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ooof!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Agggh!
One of the badgers rears up on its hind legs, and makes a high-pitched cackling noise...

nodes.speaker: Badger
nodes.text: Hhhh hhh hhh!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Did that badger just laugh at us?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's some kind of demon, man! Go! `Go!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's some kind of demon, man! Go! [color=#e23b3b][i]Go![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt frantically scampers forward, dragging Tom after him. The two push through the bushes...
And burst out of the foliage, right off a tall, steep ledge overlooking the raging stream!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Aaaaaieeeeeee!
Thirty painful minutes later, Tom and Colt walk into the Den of The Immortals. They're soaking wet, bruised, and battered.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hfff... Hff... We made it...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Your initiations suck!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Mmmm, perhaps it is you that sucks, Hades? Seeing as how you arrived nearly an hour `after` the other team?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Mmmm, perhaps it is you that sucks, Hades? Seeing as how you arrived nearly an hour [color=#e23b3b][i]after[/i][/color] the other team?!

nodes.text: Colt looks over to the couch, where Mark and Lee are hanging out.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hey dude.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: We ordered pizza.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Any left?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: One slice of pineapple.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Awww... I `hate` pineapple...
nodes.text_bbcode: Awww... I [color=#e23b3b][i]hate[/i][/color] pineapple...

nodes.text: Tom and Colt approach a tall ridge...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Colt! Look! I can see the lights of the school down below! We must be getting close!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh! Looks like you're right! Except...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Except?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Except if those are the lights of the school... Then what are `those` lights in the bushes?
nodes.text_bbcode: Except if those are the lights of the school... Then what are [color=#e23b3b][i]those[/i][/color] lights in the bushes?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The ones... Slowly moving... Towards us...?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Colt... Those aren't lights...
The bushes near the two guys rustle and part...
Revealing several enormous badgers!

nodes.speaker: Badger
nodes.text: Hsss! Snarl!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Agggh! Badgers!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Not just any badgers... Honey badgers! The most fearsome mammal on the planet! They don't care about `anything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not just any badgers... Honey badgers! The most fearsome mammal on the planet! They don't care about [color=#e23b3b][i]anything![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Is this part of the test?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know! These Immortal guys really seem to hate animals!
Growling and hissing, the badgers slowly lumber towards the two guys...

nodes.speaker: Badger
nodes.text: Nddss flssh!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I think he just said he needs flesh!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do we do? They're gonna kill us!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I say we...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's the spirit!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's just get this over with, all right? The stupid handcuff's chafing at my wrist.
Colt and Tom approach the rushing water's edge...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ready?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As I'll ever be. Let's do this.
The two take a deep breath and jump in together...
Immediately getting swept down by the current!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aggggh! Too fast! Too fast!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Swim! Come on! `Swim!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Swim! Come on! [color=#e23b3b][i]Swim![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The two guys paddle frantically, but can't coordinate their motions! The raging stream carries them down a ways, before dumping them onto a rocky beach!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Huff... Huff...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Who knew... You can't swim... While handcuffed?!
Colt pulls himself up, shaking water out of his ears.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gee, I don't know, Tom! I kind of figured that's the kind of thing you'd know, what with the swim team and all!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We didn't swim handcuffed!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then it wasn't much of a swim team, was it?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...We'll address your baffling understanding of water sports later. For now, we need to get back on track.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Good luck...
And so, after a long and soggy trek through the woods...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? I can do this!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, man, I don't care if you think you're a freaking mermaid...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm telling you, there is `no way` we can make it across a raging stream handcuffed to each other. It's just impossible.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm telling you, there is [color=#e23b3b][i]no way[/i][/color] we can make it across a raging stream handcuffed to each other. It's just impossible.

nodes.text: Tom looks out at the water and sighs...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...I suppose you're right.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Though, for the record, I fancy myself a mer`man...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Though, for the record, I fancy myself a mer[color=#e23b3b][i]man...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's just keep what you fancy to yourself, okay?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So what's the game plan? Walk around until we find another way?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We could do that, or...
Colt leads Tom over to a tall, rotting tree by the water's edge.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You thinking what I'm thinking?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The Swiss market for pork bellies is sure to decline in the coming fiscal quarter?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Just help me push this tree.
Tom and Colt press their backs to the tree. They heave as hard as they can...
And it snaps off its stump, toppling down and making a perfect bridge across the water!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ha! Perfect!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well-played, Colt. Well-played.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now let's get back to the stupid society!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: `Secret` society.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Secret[/i][/color] society.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whatever.
The guys walk carefully across the log and into the woods.
And soon enough...
Colt struggles to keep his composure...
But gag on the fumes!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Urrrrp!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't... Do this!
Colt staggers forward and tumbles out of the stables, sprawling face-down on the polo field!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ufff... `Uffff.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ufff... [color=#e23b3b][i]Uffff.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Can't... Do it... That place... Smells terrible...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No one should ever... Have to clean that...
The Spartan high janitor steps up to you...

nodes.speaker: Janitor
nodes.text: `I` will have to clean that.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] will have to clean that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Sorry.
The janitor sadly walks in, carrying a mop and a bucket.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Well, this touching lesson in class consciousness aside, it looks like you've failed the last trial.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Does that mean I've lost the initiation? I `hate` losing...
nodes.text_bbcode: Does that mean I've lost the initiation? I [color=#e23b3b][i]hate[/i][/color] losing...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Oh, no, you're fine. You only had to complete eight out of the twelve trials.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? Then why did I even do the last four?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Because it was funny to me. Now come on! Let's get you back to the council...
A little while later, Colt and Carson pull up outside a huge mansion. They walk through the gates to a huge, sprawling garden.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: All right, Chuckles, where are we?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: My dad's manor. And before you say anything, yes, he's super-rich, and no, he's not home.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: How do you even get so rich?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: He invented the piggy bank. Before that, kids just kept their change in jars. Very sad.
Something big rustles in the bushes!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Oh, my dad's this whole nature nut. This place is kind of a wildlife preserve. It's where you'll begin your Solo Trial.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not going to like this, am I?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Almost certainly not. The myth you'll be recreating is the `Twelve Labors of Hercules.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Almost certainly not. The myth you'll be recreating is the [color=#e23b3b][i]Twelve Labors of Hercules.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: The first thing Hercules did was slay the Nemean Lion...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You want me to slay a lion?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Not a lion, per se, more of a puma. And you don't have to slay it, just steal a tuft of its fur.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You can find its pen a little ways down. Have fun!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stupid secret society...
A few minutes later, Colt comes stumbling back, with his shirt torn and his hair tussled. He triumphantly waves a fistful of fur.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ha! Done! I showed that puma who's boss!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's my next task?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Well, after defeating the Nemean Lion, Hercules fought the Erymanthian Boar!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on!
A boar, a deer, a bull, a dog, and some birds later, Colt stands panting in the middle of the clearing...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Wow, I have to say, I'm actually pretty impressed. You'll be happy to hear you're done with the animal labors...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Finally...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: But you still have a few left. Next, you'll have to kidnap the Queen of the Amazons...
Colt rushes across the lawn of Monarch Prep with Paige slung across his shoulders...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I am totally fine with this!
And soon enough, on the Spartan Polo field...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: All right! Eleven labors done!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Just one last labor to do... The most unpleasant of all... To clean the Aegean stables!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Or in this case... The Spartan Academy polo stables!
Carson throws open a set of doors, revealing the stables where all of the horses for the polo team reside. The overpowering stench of manure wafts out!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Oh!` That is `horrible!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oh![/i][/color] That is [color=#e23b3b][i]horrible![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It smells way worse than the last time I was here...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yep. In anticipation of this trial, Percy asked the groundskeepers not to clean it!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: To pass the trial, you're going to have to make it spotless. Also, you have ten minutes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Since when do I have ten minutes?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Since I got bored! Go!
Carson steps back. Colt scrambles in and grabs a hose at the far end.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay... Just need to keep it together... And ignore the smell...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The terrible, `terrible` smell...
nodes.text_bbcode: The terrible, [color=#e23b3b][i]terrible[/i][/color] smell...

nodes.text: Colt turns the spigot on the hose and starts spraying!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, what?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not going to fight Tom. He's my friend, and this doesn't feel right.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Either you take both of us... Or neither. Isn't that right, Tom?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Yeah. Yeah, it is.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Fine! They're both out, then! Let's go get Lee and Mark!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: No. We already told them they were out. There's no going back on that...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Plus, you know, they're already probably back in their dorms, and I really don't feel like going to get them...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You can't be serious, guys! We're not letting them both in!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, that's `exactly` what we're doing.
nodes.text_bbcode: As a matter of fact, that's [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] what we're doing.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: We opened up this possibility when we let them both compete... And according to the bylaws of our society, they've both won the Trials.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: If they refuse to compete... We have no choice.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Hades... Apollo... Welcome to The Immortals!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well then! Let's just get settled and...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold your horses, Shagri La, because I'm not done talking.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm starting to accept that this secret society might just be the right thing for me to get my life in order...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I am `not` happy with the way you do things here.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] happy with the way you do things here.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Go on...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For starters, Centerscore might be our biggest rival, but we're done with dumb pranks like ruining their football field. We've done enough damage.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If we're so worried about beating them, let's do it in a fair and honest competition.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: This is ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's the way it is, Meathead. Either the feud between Spartan and Centerscore ends...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or Tom and I are out.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: This is totally out of line! `Totally!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is totally out of line! [color=#e23b3b][i]Totally![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: He can't just come in here and change how we do things!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yeah, this doesn't seem okay...
Percy stares at Colt thoughtfully... Then smiles a wry, tricky grin.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: ...Offer accepted.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?! You've got to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Hades here has an excellent point. We've wasted too much effort on those losers at Centerscore already. If leaving them alone is his price... We'll pay it.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No! This is seriously not okay! I... I formally protest!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And I will formally tell you to shut your cartoonishly loud mouth, Ares, or I swear by the Gods above and below, I will kick you out of this society.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Need I remind you... This is `not` a democracy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Need I remind you... This is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a democracy.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: It's in the bylaws. Volume 15, Article 9. 'This is not a democracy.'

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hmph!
Chad storms furiously out. Colt watches him go, then walks over and sits on the couch.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So... What's the first thing on our agenda? Are there any international markets to manipulate? Political lobbies to infiltrate?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Tell me you have insider stock tips! Because let me tell you, I have a feeling about these Swiss pork bellies...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Slow your roll, good Apollo! All that comes later! First, enjoy some of our society's special amenities!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Amenities?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What exactly are we talking about here?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well, beyond the use of this excellent lounge...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You get to enjoy priority registration in classes at Spartan...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You mean, I can take all afternoon classes and sleep in every morning?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Exactly! Not only that, but we receive custom-catered lunches... VIP treatment at all the clubs and restaurants in town... Regular consultations from a personal stylist...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really...?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And if you feel like visiting a special ladyfriend, there's a hidden tunnel that runs from this den across the river to Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: My special ladyfriend actually goes to Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Mmm. We'll deal with that later.
Percy walks off. Tom walks over and sits down on the couch next to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey. What you did back there? That was... Very gentlemanly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't sweat it, man. It was the right thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: After everything we've been through together... It would've felt wrong to end on those terms.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You know, Colt, you told me that you wanted to come to Spartan to be a better man...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But sometimes, I think you might already be the best man here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks, man, but don't get all sappy on me. Mostly I just didn't feel like bruising you up!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha, well, it's funny that you say that because... You do know I'd win, right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You seriously think you'd win in a fight against me?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, as a matter of fact I do. And just so it's clear, I'm talking about a fair fight, not you sneaking up on me in an alley with a crowbar.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Listen here, Richie, I could take you in a fair fight with a blindfold on and one hand tied behind my back!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha! Well, I could take `you` with a blindfold, one hand behind my back, `and` a rabid chimp on my shoulders!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! Well, I could take [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] with a blindfold, one hand behind my back, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] a rabid chimp on my shoulders!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Well, I could...
Looks like Tom and Colt made it into The Immortals... And preserved their friendship! Their... Very odd... Friendship!
Congratulations on playing a great game!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: A few minutes later, Colt and Carson walk back into The Immortals' lair, where everyone else is gathered.
Carson joins the other members at the front of the room. Colt takes a seat next to Tom.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You doing okay, Fancypants?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Barely. That trial was `brutal.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Barely. That trial was [color=#e23b3b][i]brutal.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Mine too. What'd you have to do?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The Trial of Tantalus. They put this `incredible` three-course dinner in front of me, and I had to resist taking even a bite!
nodes.text_bbcode: The Trial of Tantalus. They put this [color=#e23b3b][i]incredible[/i][/color] three-course dinner in front of me, and I had to resist taking even a bite!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait, seriously?! Your entire trial was to `not` eat a meal? That's it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, seriously?! Your entire trial was to [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] eat a meal? That's it?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Have you ever had Kobe beef, Colt? I realize you probably subsist off potatoes and rye bread and, I don't know, lumps of coal, but you have no idea what I went through...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `I fought a freaking lion!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I fought a freaking lion![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Technically a puma.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Silence!
Percy steps to the front of the room and officially clears his throat.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: I have conferred with the other members of this society, and we have decided that all four of you pass to the next trial!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yay! I sure hope Tom doesn't have to `not` eat any more fancy meat!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yay! I sure hope Tom doesn't have to [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] eat any more fancy meat!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: His name is Apollo, and it's funny that you bring him up, Hades... Because for the next trial, the two of you are partners.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We're what now?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: That's right. The second trial is a Duo Trial! Hades, you're with Apollo. Poseidon, you're with Hephaestus.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Sounds good to me.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Yeah, we're a pretty good team.
Colt and Tom glance at each other.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, we're pretty good too. I mean, this one time, we were on these ski slopes, and...
Before Colt can finish, Chad steps over and clasps Colt and Tom's wrists in handcuffs, binding them together!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Naw, man, naw, after San Francisco, I promised myself I'd never be in handcuffs again...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Take them away!
While Tom and Colt struggle, the other guys shove hoods over their heads and drag them out to a van...
And a little while later, they're forced out the back onto a rough patch of dirt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Ooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ooof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The van races off into the darkness. The two guys pull off their hoods and look around. They're deep in the woods, with no trail or path anywhere in sight.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Dude, this secret society better be the best thing in the world, because I am starting to get seriously sick of this...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Tell me about it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So what's the challenge here? Getting back to school in one piece?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That'd be my guess.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We were only in that van for about fifteen minutes, so we can't be far. My guess is we're in those big woods just north of Spartan.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That sounds right to me. In that case, what we want to do is head due south.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right. Good plan. Now we just need to figure out which way is due south.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sure thing. I'll just...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold on, Tom, I'm thinking this through. We're supposed to look at the moss on trees, right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If the trees have moss growing on them, it means we're in the north!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, wait, that can't be right.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Actually, Colt, we can just...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not now, Tom, I'm thinking! Maybe we can make a compass... I saw this in a movie... We'll need a cup of water and a needle and a magnet...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: `Colt!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Colt![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Tom holds up his un-handcuffed wrist.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I have a compass in my watch!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes. Not to mention a barometer, a thermometer, an odometer, and a speedometer.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Also, it dispenses shaving cream.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's it like to be literally made of money?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What's it like to not know how to correctly use the word 'literally'? Now come on!
The two of them follow Tom's compass south for some time...
And come to a rushing stream that blocks their path!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, this isn't great.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're telling me. We're going to have to figure some way to cross. That's gonna take some time...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why don't we just swim it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You want to swim that?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sure, why not?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Don't tell me you don't know how to swim. Is that one of those things they don't teach poor people?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, I know how to swim, jerk. I just don't think we can swim `that.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I know how to swim, jerk. I just don't think we can swim [color=#e23b3b][i]that.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, `I` certainly can. I was on the swim team for three years, you know...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] certainly can. I was on the swim team for three years, you know...

nodes.text: Tom jerks on the handcuff connecting him to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But I can't exactly do it on my own... So I guess it's your call.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, it is. And I say we...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: In a first for The Immortals, we've got a tie!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: The two most qualified members for our society... Are Hades and Apollo!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes! Team Hapollo does it again!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Please don't call us that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, that was a horrible mistake, sorry.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Man, this sucks.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Yeah, forget this.
Mark and Lee walk out.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So... We're good? The two of us are in?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Oh, no, not at all!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm afraid I do...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: The two of you must decide who joins The Immortals...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: By fighting it out!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! That's right! The two of you are gonna have to fight like dogs... And the last one standing wins!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Is this the only option? We have to fight each other?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 'Fraid so, boys. Get to it.
The other Immortals back away. Tom and Colt look at each other warily...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We really gonna do this?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We've jumped through all their other hoops. Seems like a shame to back out now...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well... Whoever wins... It's been an honor.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Same here, man. Same here.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Let's do this.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tom, wait, I...
Tom lunges forward, throwing a hard right jab at Colt's head!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Whoa!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whoa![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt dodges to the side, neatly weaving away from the punch!
Tom stumbles for a moment... Leaving himself wide open!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Only one thing to do...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, what?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not going to fight Tom. He's my friend, and this doesn't feel right.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Either you take both of us... Or neither. Isn't that right, Tom?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Yeah. Yeah, it is.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Fine! They're both out, then! Let's go get Lee and Mark!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: No. We already told them they were out. There's no going back on that...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Plus, you know, they're already probably back in their dorms, and I really don't feel like going to get them...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You can't be serious, guys! We're not letting them both in!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, that's `exactly` what we're doing.
nodes.text_bbcode: As a matter of fact, that's [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] what we're doing.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: We opened up this possibility when we let them both compete... And according to the bylaws of our society, they've both won the Trials.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: If they refuse to compete... We have no choice.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Hades... Apollo... Welcome to The Immortals!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well then! Let's just get settled and...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold your horses, Shagri La, because I'm not done talking.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm starting to accept that this secret society might just be the right thing for me to get my life in order...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I am `not` happy with the way you do things here.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] happy with the way you do things here.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Go on...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For starters, Centerscore might be our biggest rival, but we're done with dumb pranks like ruining their football field. We've done enough damage.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If we're so worried about beating them, let's do it in a fair and honest competition.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: This is ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's the way it is, Meathead. Either the feud between Spartan and Centerscore ends...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or Tom and I are out.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: This is totally out of line! `Totally!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is totally out of line! [color=#e23b3b][i]Totally![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: He can't just come in here and change how we do things!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yeah, this doesn't seem okay...
Percy stares at Colt thoughtfully... Then smiles a wry, tricky grin.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: ...Offer accepted.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?! You've got to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Hades here has an excellent point. We've wasted too much effort on those losers at Centerscore already. If leaving them alone is his price... We'll pay it.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No! This is seriously not okay! I... I formally protest!

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And I will formally tell you to shut your cartoonishly loud mouth, Ares, or I swear by the Gods above and below, I will kick you out of this society.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Need I remind you... This is `not` a democracy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Need I remind you... This is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a democracy.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: It's in the bylaws. Volume 15, Article 9. 'This is not a democracy.'

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hmph!
Chad storms furiously out. Colt watches him go, then walks over and sits on the couch.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So... What's the first thing on our agenda? Are there any international markets to manipulate? Political lobbies to infiltrate?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Tell me you have insider stock tips! Because let me tell you, I have a feeling about these Swiss pork bellies...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Slow your roll, good Apollo! All that comes later! First, enjoy some of our society's special amenities!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Amenities?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What exactly are we talking about here?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Well, beyond the use of this excellent lounge...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: You get to enjoy priority registration in classes at Spartan...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You mean, I can take all afternoon classes and sleep in every morning?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Exactly! Not only that, but we receive custom-catered lunches... VIP treatment at all the clubs and restaurants in town... Regular consultations from a personal stylist...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really...?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And if you feel like visiting a special ladyfriend, there's a hidden tunnel that runs from this den across the river to Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: My special ladyfriend actually goes to Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Mmm. We'll deal with that later.
Percy walks off. Tom walks over and sits down on the couch next to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey. What you did back there? That was... Very gentlemanly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't sweat it, man. It was the right thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: After everything we've been through together... It would've felt wrong to end on those terms.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You know, Colt, you told me that you wanted to come to Spartan to be a better man...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But sometimes, I think you might already be the best man here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks, man, but don't get all sappy on me. Mostly I just didn't feel like bruising you up!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha, well, it's funny that you say that because... You do know I'd win, right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You seriously think you'd win in a fight against me?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, as a matter of fact I do. And just so it's clear, I'm talking about a fair fight, not you sneaking up on me in an alley with a crowbar.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Listen here, Richie, I could take you in a fair fight with a blindfold on and one hand tied behind my back!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha! Well, I could take `you` with a blindfold, one hand behind my back, `and` a rabid chimp on my shoulders!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! Well, I could take [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] with a blindfold, one hand behind my back, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] a rabid chimp on my shoulders!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Well, I could...
Looks like Tom and Colt made it into The Immortals... And preserved their friendship! Their... Very odd... Friendship!
Congratulations on playing a great game!
